title: Promo
description: A discount acme applies on its own initiative, to every eligible cart, without the customer asking.

source.description: Union tag distinguishing an automatic promo from a presented coupon.

campaign-id.description: Campaign that funds this promo. Its budget is what stops the promo.

segment-id.description: Audience segment this promo is restricted to. Absent means every cart is eligible.

precedence.description: Tie-break rank within a campaign. Lower wins; equal ranks are resolved by promo id.

starts-at.description: First instant the promo is offered. RFC 3339, UTC.

ends-at.description: First instant it is no longer offered; exclusive, so windows abut without overlapping.
